overview: Nvidia pauses Southeast Asian shipments amid U.S. export compliance concerns
DeepMind lets AI agents manage compute for Gemini experiments, highlighting safety controls
Regulators target AI firms over data use and consumer protection

top.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
top.summary: Nvidia ordered partners to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia while checking compliance with U.S. export rules, after China accessed its chips remotely, a loophole recently closed.

top.title: AI agents now control part of DeepMind's compute for Gemini experiments
top.summary: DeepMind uses AI agents to run part of the compute for Gemini model experiments, with safety checks that keep agents' internal reasoning visible and unrewarded to maintain oversight.

top.title: AI made self-hosting fun again
top.summary: A self‑hoster reports AI coding assistants now streamline infrastructure changes, reducing setup time from days to hours and making experimentation with complex tools like NixOS feasible.

top.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
top.summary: Meta refused the UK FCA’s request to jointly test its Muse assistant, prompting regulator concerns about consumer protection, payment handling, and AI transparency as Muse expands in the UK.

top.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
top.summary: A coalition of 42 U.S. state attorneys general seeks to block Character.AI’s plan to sell chat histories, including minors’ data, citing lack of safeguards during its Chapter 11 proceedings.

top.title: AI may soon change what it means to be a theoretical physicist
top.summary: Physicist Suvrat Raju’s benchmark shows advanced LLMs solving up to 90% of novel theoretical physics problems, raising questions about AI’s role in research and benchmark saturation.
